**Slides.** [Open the deck at this part](../../slides/eu-frames-one-day-data-tools.html#/part-4-explore-declare-publish){target="_blank"} in its own tab, or follow it on the [slides page](slides.qmd).

Part 4 turns the work of the day into a record that somebody else can find and rerun: a report rendered from the start, a history of its changes, and a place where it is deposited. One slide on the curve of alternative analyses of the claim shows why that record matters.

| Work through | What you do | Timing |
|---|---|---|
| Slides, the report as a record, with [Quarto and reproducible documents](../../companion/quarto.qmd) as the companion | What `index.qmd` in the workspace holds, what rendering does, and what the render leaves behind. | 8 minutes |
| Slides, version control in practice, with [Git and GitHub](../../companion/git-github.qmd) as the companion | Initialising a repository, committing, reading a diff, and how the workspace publishes itself from GitHub; shown on the screen of the facilitator. | 12 minutes |
| The report in the workspace, or your notes | Hands-on 4: fill the TODO of Task 3 with the analyst, the t and its degrees of freedom and one sentence on how its model differs from the other two, add the check of Hands-on 3a as a chunk, and render; with git, commit and read a diff. In the browser lab only, copy the cell, its output and the check into your notes. | 35 minutes |
| Slides, the curve of the claim | 864 defensible analyses of the claim on one panel, with the five Multi100 results among them, as the reason that readable code matters. | 5 minutes |
| Slides, open research infrastructures, with [Reproducibility repositories](../../companion/repositories.qmd) and [Social science data sources](../../companion/data-sources.qmd) as the companions | Archives, statistical offices, repositories and registries; the data of the case and the terms on which they are held; three minutes in the [SCORE dossier](https://osf.io/h7432) on the OSF. | 15 minutes |
| Slides, the close | What you take with you, and the feedback form. | 5 minutes |

**By the end of the part** your reproduction sits in a rendered report or in your notes, with the check that would have caught the slip of your analyst, and you know where a finished analysis is deposited and on what terms.
